decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the blue powder coating  to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.
description: Installation of ventilation ducting to rear elevation and installation of new louvres to rear windows on ground level, replacement of existing side window with a door and vent over and installation of extract fans to side elevation wall of existing building
